comment: What every helper's redaction must do, whatever its language and regex engine: for each case, `text` joined becomes `expected` joined, where {redacted} stands for redactors.json's `placeholder`.
Texts are split into fragments so that no line of this file holds anything shaped like a real key; the bodies are made up.

`lineCases` are for redacting several texts together, each keeping its share. A line is one or more texts that follow one another with nothing between (the text before the caret, the selection, the text after it); the lines are redacted as the one text they make, a line break between them. Of a match, what its replacement starts with as the match does stays in the texts that held it. The rest of the replacement, up to what it ends with as the match does, goes to the text the rest of the match began in; every later boundary between texts in the match lands before that kept end, so a text wholly inside the secret comes back empty. The two kept parts never overlap.
